title: NASA Lost A Mars Probe Over A Unit Mix-Up 🚀
caption:
NASA lost a Mars probe because of a unit mix-up 🚀
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1999 the Mars Climate Orbiter was lost because one team supplied thruster data in pound-force seconds while the navigation team expected newton-seconds. The probe came in far too low and was lost. The mission cost well over 100 million dollars.
Metric or imperial? 👇
first_comment: Metric or imperial? One of them cost NASA a Mars probe. 🚀👇
